sourceAndConfiguration.cacheByteBudget: N/A: representation microbenchmark; no production LRU configured
sourceAndConfiguration.nodeBudget: N/A: one root node is compared per real dataset
sourceAndConfiguration.browserWorkers: 0: Node direct-backend path; no browser Worker pool

transformations.verticalDatum: as declared by the dataset WKT and current forward path; no geoid correction added by the benchmark

sourceAndConfiguration.datasetReadMode: local file-backed Blob; no network timing or HTTP request data

method.timingSummary: all timings are milliseconds; every summary includes sampleCount, p50, nearest-rank p95, min, max, mean, sample variance, standard deviation, coefficient of variation, and raw measured samples
method.coldBackend: fresh backend instance and freshly loaded hierarchy per sample; operating-system/file page cache is not flushed
method.warmBackend: same opened backend instance reused across point-node samples
method.candidateMaterialization: each candidate copies the same completed transformation outputs into fresh retained typed arrays; requested attributes and statistics are shared unchanged; this measures materialization/allocation, not a second CRS transform
method.inverseBatchHelper: benchmark-only wrapper reuses ecefToGeographic; interleaved Float64 XYZ input, exact pointCount*3 validation, finite-value validation, optional distinct exact-length Float64 output, and degree/degree/metre output semantics
method.color: full Float32 RGBA CPU buffer construction using getCopcPointColor for fixed/elevation/RGB/intensity/classification; cold samples allocate a new buffer and warm samples reuse one while toggling every mode
method.colorBoundary: D is compared to A across the observed height range and engineered normalized palette boundaries at multiple height spans; boundary sensitivity ranges are synthetic checks, not actual display settings
method.picking: one and one hundred deterministic point inspections; A/B read cached Geographic triples; C/D use scalar ecefToGeographic; D uses cached Float32 display height
method.backends: default copc-js plus TypeScript and explicitly selected Rust/WASM, measured separately on the same local file, root node, and requested fields; this runner does not exercise browser Workers
method.synthetic: 10k/100k/250k/1M deterministic WGS84 positions; counts above 250k are benchmark-only and exceed typical production point budgets
method.data: Autzen is required; SoFi runs only when COPC_CACHE_BENCHMARK_SOFI=1; each local file size and registered SHA-256 are reported

float64NumericalRegressionBounds.source: existing packages/test/core/streaming/view-query.test.mjs inverse-transform regression test; software round-trip bounds only

accuracyAcceptance.float32AdoptionThreshold: UNSET: repository has no independent survey/control-point requirement for candidate D; measured errors are reported without claiming survey accuracy or adoption acceptance
accuracyAcceptance.existingCrsConformance: CRS audit tolerances are operation/software conformance bounds, not independent survey accuracy

limitations: local Blob range reads do not represent remote HTTP latency or file-change/offline behavior
process memory snapshots are checkpoints; transient allocation peak, per-worker residency, and WASM linear-memory residency cannot be isolated in this direct Node run
browser Worker encode/transfer/return, renderer submission, GPU memory, frame p50/p95, and main-thread Long Tasks are N/A in the Node harness
actual streaming LRU hit/miss/eviction and camera revisit Range request behavior require the browser-stage run
synthetic and checked-in CRS fixtures exercise coordinate math but do not provide surveyed control points; no real geoid grid is included
source XYZ re-read decodes a whole local COPC node; remote HTTP latency, remote file replacement, and offline failure are not measured
memory inventories count reachable ArrayBuffer backing stores exactly once and separately show typed attributes/statistics/aliases; JavaScript object overhead is engine-specific and reported N/A
